snip.t: The differential diagnosis includes hyperplastic primary vitreous, Coats disease, cataract, visceral larva migrans, choroidal coloboma, and retinopathy of prematurity.

Retina and vitreous
• Retinopathy of prematurity (ROP)
– Prematurity, hyperoxia, and general illness
– From mild to severe progressive vasoproliferative scarring and blinding retinal
detachment
– Treatment—cryosurgery or laser photocoagulation
